rebuttal_or_critique: While my conviction remains that a 25 bps hike is the most prudent path to safeguard the 4% target against the 7.44% inflation print and 11.51% food inflation, I recognize the emerging consensus within the committee to pause. The priority now is to ensure the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance is executed with absolute resolve, particularly regarding the 120,000 crore liquidity surplus, to ensure that the current supply-side shocks do not translate into entrenched inflation expectations. I will defer to the collective wisdom of the committee to maintain the repo rate at 6.50% while emphasizing that our vigilance remains uncompromised.
